critical_code_review_comments: story-morph.tsx: COMMIT_AT=0.85 correctly defers reader mount to visual end of the ease-out cubic (~0.3% distance left = sub-pixel), so the heavy mount cannot steal frames from a moving cover. The 900ms absolute safety net (lines 179-188) plus the COMMIT_AT-scaled setTimeout keep the overlay from ever getting stuck even if measurement never lands.

morph-host.tsx: settle synchronization via armHomeSettle/homeSettled/waitHomeSettled with HOME_SETTLE_MAX_MS=240 correctly waits for the Home to reflow (e.g., when a new resume-reading-card mounts) before re-measuring the return rect. This eliminates the intermediate-frame handoff that previously caused stutter at close.
